population_note_text: Books population (optional, cancelled and post-dated vouchers excluded); Contra excluded throughout. A loan ledger's interest journals are vouchers whose only other ledger line is its configured interest ledger (the client's list of loans); every other voucher touching the loan ledger is a taken (credit) or repaid (debit) transaction, never classified by ledger name.

Debits to loan ledger (tag 977bdd42) other than its interest journals -- amount repaid in the year, before any Clause 31/s.269T lender-exemption or mode filter.

Whether the assessee must deduct TDS under s.194A for the year -- the same rule and figure as 'TDS on payments made': firm/LLP/company always; individual/HUF only if previous-year business turnover exceeded the rules' turnover limit for an individual or HUF.

The configured interest ledger name for loan ledger (tag 977bdd42), or '' if the loan is interest-free -- this test's own consistency checks read it back to check each voucher on this loan and that ledger independently of the test's own bucketing.
Interest paid/credited on loan ledger (tag 977bdd42): sum of every voucher whose only other line is its configured interest ledger.
Lender type for loan ledger (tag 977bdd42) from the client's list of loans, classified by the loan ledger this interest pairs with -- never by a word in the ledger name.

Running maximum of the outstanding balance owed to the lender on loan ledger (tag 977bdd42) during the year (opening balance, then after every taken/repaid entry in date order) -- the utility's MaxAmtOsAccPy column.
Loan ledgers with a non-exempt lender whose interest this year exceeds the s.194A threshold and for which the assessee is a deductor.
Reportable taken/repaid rows in cash/journal/other mode at or over the s.269SS/269T limit (₹20,000).

findings.title_text: Loan taken against invented NBFC, not a real entity (cash mode, code B) -- at or over the s.269SS/269T running-balance limit
limits_text: Books only: confirm the lender's identity (name, address, PAN) for Form 3CD Clause 31, and whether this lender is excepted from s.269SS/269T beyond the lender types the rules already except (Government, a notified corporation, or another body notified under the Explanation).

The mode-and-direction code follows the Form 3CD utility's own Note 1 list (A/B cash payment/receipt, I/J journal entry debit/credit, K/L any other mode debit/credit); this pack's own mapping from mode and direction to that code is a derivation from the GN's text, not verified against a specimen utility export -- confirm.

Mode is read from the counter-line ledger's group only (Cash-in-Hand), never from the narration: this voucher's narration is 'Synthetic voucher R/8'. A narration naming an electronic instrument (e.g. UPI/PhonePe) booked through a cash ledger takes this outside s.269SS/269T even though the ledger group says 'cash' -- confirm from the narration and the bank statement before treating this as a cash breach.
s.273B reasonable cause (e.g. banking facilities not available in the area) is a CA judgement call on the facts, not a books fact.
ask_client_text: Confirm lender identity (name, address, PAN) for Clause 31.
Confirm from narration/bank statement whether this was genuinely cash or an electronic transfer narrated against a cash ledger.

findings.title_text: Deductor status for s.194A depends on previous-year turnover
limits_text: An individual/HUF is a s.194A deductor only if the immediately preceding year's business turnover exceeded ₹1 crore; the current year's books alone cannot establish this.
